name: Atlantic Technological University
summary: Technological university on campuses from Galway and Mayo to Sligo and Donegal: about 140 honours degrees via CAO, most needing only basic Maths.

ib.text: Six subjects with English (or Irish) and usually Maths; no third language. Strictest: Sligo Engineering HL Maths 5. ATU asks non-native speakers for IELTS 6.5 'or equivalent'; CAO accepts IB English A SL 4.

programmes.name: Mechanical Engineering (Sligo)
programmes.about: Theory, practicals and workshops in mechanical and manufacturing engineering, with CAD/CAM, automation, 3D printing and CNC facilities, ethics and sustainability, and a work placement in year 3, semester 2.
programmes.ib: HL Maths 5 and SL 4 in English, inside the CAO rule of HL 5 in two subjects and SL 4 in four more.
programmes.selectionNote: Places go on CAO points. ATU may share places out by exam system and rank IB applicants among themselves.
programmes.tuitionEuEea: €2,500 a year, as ATU lists it

flagshipSource.title: ATU Mechanical Engineering: CAD/CAM and CNC labs; final-year projects have won national competitions

programmes.name: Fine Art (Sligo)
programmes.about: Drawing, painting, digital media, photography and video, ceramics, printmaking and sculpture, building your own artistic practice through research and self-directed work in a new creative teaching hub with dedicated studios.
programmes.ib: HL 5 in two subjects and SL 4 in four more, including English. Maths is not required. An online portfolio is required.
programmes.selectionNote: An online portfolio of ten finished works plus studies and notebooks earns up to 100 points. 2026 rounds were 20 March, 8 May and 5 July; 2027 dates not yet published.
programmes.tuitionEuEea: €2,500 a year, as ATU lists it

flagshipSource.title: ATU Fine Art: taught in a new €17 million creative teaching hub with dedicated studios and workshops

faculties.name: Faculty of Engineering and Computing
faculties.line: Common-entry engineering at three campuses, Level 7 or Level 8; Sligo Mechanical Engineering asks HL Maths 5.

faculties.name: Faculty of Science and Health
faculties.line: Science (Common Entry) lets you choose your specialisation later; courses run on six campuses.

faculties.name: Faculty of Business
faculties.line: Business courses on five campuses from Level 6 to four-year Level 8 honours, with common entry at Donegal.

faculties.name: Faculty of Design, Education and Social Science
faculties.line: Over 30 design and creative arts courses on four campuses; Fine Art asks for an online portfolio worth up to 100 points.

notes: Where one exam system dominates a course's applicants, ATU may share its places out by system and rank IB applicants among themselves.
Art, Fine Art and Animation ask for a portfolio as well as points.
The same subject is often taught on more than one campus under different CAO codes, so check the campus before you list a code.
